description: One call for a project you do not know yet, or when something is broken and you do not know where to start: runs the review and, when Godot is installed, loads every script and scene with Godot; groups the findings by cause (twenty findings from one missing file are one problem), puts the most urgent first (Godot's errors, then the review's), and gives each the place, the lesson from real projects that explains it, the fix, and whether godot_fix or godot_migrate can do it. Pass `symptom` with what you see going wrong ("helicopter bounces on the moving deck") to add the lessons for it. Ends with numbered next steps. Read-only. Use godot_review for the full list and godot_check for Godot's raw output.

detail.description: brief: short output with capped lists; full: everything (default for this cheap profile: brief).

files.description: only problems in these res:// files

godot.description: run Godot too when it is installed (default true)

path.description: The project folder, or any file or folder inside it (Godotwright walks up to project.godot). Relative paths start at the server's folder. Default: the current project.

symptom.description: what you see going wrong, in plain words

name: godot_doctor
title: What is wrong, and in which order to fix it
